title: UneceTradeAddress
description: The location at which a particular trade related organization or person may be found or reached.

additionalStreetName.description: The additional name of a street, expressed as text, for this trade address.

addressTypeCode.description: A code specifying the type of this trade address, such as business address or home address.

attentionOf.description:
The name, expressed as text, of a person or department in the organization to whom incoming mail is marked with words
such as 'for the attention of' or 'FAO' or 'ATTN' for this trade address.

buildingName.description: The name, expressed as text, of a building, a house or other structure on a street at this trade address.

buildingNumber.description: The building number, expressed as text, in this trade address.

careOf.description:
The name, expressed as text, of a person or organization at this trade address to whom incoming mail is marked with
words such as 'care of' or 'C/O'.

cityId.description: The identifier of the city for this trade address, such as United Nations Location Code (UNLOCODE).

cityName.description: A name, expressed as text, of the city, town or village of this trade address.

citySubDivisionName.description: A name, expressed as text, of a sub-division of a city for this trade address, for example a district or borough.

countryIdentificationCountry.description: The unique identifier of the country for this trade address.

countryName.description: A name, expressed as text, of the country for this trade address.

countrySubDivisionId.description: A unique identifier of the country sub-division for this trade address.

countrySubDivisionName.description: A name, expressed as text, of the sub-division of a country for this trade address.

departmentName.description: The name, expressed as text, of a department for this trade address.

description.description: A textual description of this trade address.

freeForm.description: A free form representation, expressed as text, of this trade address.

geoCoordinateIdentificationGeographicalC.description: An identification of a set of geographical coordinates for this trade address.

identifier.description: A unique identifier for this trade address.

invalidIndicator.description: The indication of whether or not this trade address is invalid.

lineFive.description: The fifth free form line, expressed as text, of this trade address.

lineFour.description: The fourth free form line, expressed as text, of this trade address.

lineOne.description: The first free form line, expressed as text, of this trade address.

lineThree.description: The third free form line, expressed as text, of this trade address.

lineTwo.description: The second free form line, expressed as text, of this trade address.

postOfficeBox.description:
The unique identifier, expressed as text, of a container commonly referred to as a box, in a post office or other postal
service location, assigned to a person or organization, where postal items may be kept for this trade address.

postcodeCode.description: A code specifying the postcode of this trade address.

secondaryPostcodeCode.description: A code specifying a secondary postcode of this trade address.

streetName.description: A name, expressed as text, of a street or thoroughfare for this trade address.

tradeAddressCountryId.description: The unique identifier of a country for this trade address.
